record.paper_title: Problèmes ouverts en théorie des intersections
record.context_brief: comparison from Gr' to Chow and topology
record.original_question: When X is smooth and quasi-projective over a field, does there exist a ring homomorphism g:Gr'(X)→A(X) to the Chow ring that sends Chern classes in Gr'(X) to the corresponding Chow-theoretic Chern classes? Does the analogous problem also have a solution for a compact topological space X, namely a ring homomorphism from Gr'(X), the graded ring of K'(X) for the λ-filtration, to H^{2*}(X,Z) that sends Chern classes to ordinary integral Chern classes?

evidence.quote: Lorsque X est lisse et quasi-projectif sur un corps k, on peut de même se poser la question de l'existence d'un homomorphisme d'anneaux g: Gr'(X)→A(X) à valeurs dans l'anneau de Chow A(X), transformant classes de Chern en classes de Chern.

Signalons, pour terminer ce numéro, qu'essentiellement la même question se pose si, au lieu d'un schéma X, on considère un espace topologique compact (disons) X, ce qui permet encore de considérer le gradué Gr'(X) de K'(X) muni de sa λ-filtration, et de se proposer de trouver un homomorphisme d'anneaux Gr'(X)→H^{2*}(X,Z) transformant classes de Chern en classes de Chern.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a smooth quasi-projective variety over a field k. Denote by K'(X) = K_0(X) the Grothendieck group of coherent sheaves (equivalently, of locally free sheaves, since X is smooth), endowed with its natural ring structure and with the λ-ring structure given by exterior powers. Let F^•K'(X) be the associated γ-filtration (equivalently, the Chern filtration), and set
   Gr'(X) := ⊕_{p≥0} F^p K'(X) / F^{p+1} K'(X),
the associated graded ring. For each vector bundle E on X and each integer p ≥ 0, one has Chern classes c_p^{K}(E) ∈ Gr'(X) defined via the λ-operations. Let A(X) = ⊕_p A^p(X) denote the Chow ring of X (cycles modulo rational equivalence with the intersection product), and let c_p(E) ∈ A^p(X) denote the Chow-theoretic Chern classes.

(a) Does there exist a graded ring homomorphism
        g : Gr'(X) ⟶ A(X)
that sends c_p^{K}(E) to c_p(E) for every vector bundle E on X and every p ≥ 0?

(b) (Topological analogue.) Let X be a compact topological space. Let K'(X) be the topological K-theory ring, equipped with its λ-operations and γ-filtration, and let Gr'(X) be the associated graded ring, with Chern classes c_p^{K}(E) ∈ Gr'(X) for each complex vector bundle E on X. Does there exist a graded ring homomorphism
        Gr'(X) ⟶ H^{2*}(X, ℤ) = ⊕_p H^{2p}(X, ℤ)
sending c_p^{K}(E) to the ordinary integral Chern class c_p(E) ∈ H^{2p}(X, ℤ) for every complex vector bundle E on X?
artifact.status_search_result: Rationally, the comparison maps are isomorphisms via the Chern character / Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch. Integrally, the relationship between the γ-filtration on K-theory and the Chow ring (resp. integral cohomology in the topological case) is delicate: it is known that the associated graded for the γ-filtration is in general only related to CH(X) by a surjection up to torsion, and recent works (e.g. Karpenko–Merkurjev on Chow filtrations on representation rings, Yagita's notes on filtrations of K-theory, Totaro's work on Chow rings of classifying spaces) show that the existence of a natural integral ring map Gr_γ K(X) → CH(X) sending Chern classes to Chern classes does not hold in full generality and depends on subtle conditions (e.g. whether the E_∞-page of the Atiyah–Hirzebruch spectral sequence is generated by Chern classes). The precise question as posed by Grothendieck for arbitrary smooth quasi-projective X (and for arbitrary compact spaces) does not appear to be resolved by a definitive yes/no in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Chow Filtration on Representation Rings of Algebraic Groups (Karpenko–Merkurjev)
status_evidence.snippet: For quotient varieties E/P ... the canonical homomorphism of the Chow ring CH(X) onto the graded ring associated with the coniveau filtration on the Grothendieck ring of X is an isomorphism.
status_evidence.claim: Comparison maps between CH and graded K are studied and known only in special cases.

status_evidence.title: Note on the filtrations of K-theory (Yagita)
status_evidence.snippet: The graded ring associated with the topological filtration is isomorphic to the graded gamma filtration if and only if the infinite term of the Atiyah–Hirzebruch spectral sequence is generated by Chern classes.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of a Chern-class-preserving comparison depends on subtle integral conditions.

status_evidence.title: Three filtrations on the Grothendieck ring of a scheme (Belmans)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of γ-, topological and codimension filtrations and their comparisons.
status_evidence.claim: Comparison is classical rationally but integrally remains open / partial.
